newsitem.title: UK: London Stock Exchange has first half surplus.
newsitem.headline: London Stock Exchange has first half surplus.

text.p: The London Stock Exchange said it recorded an operating surplus of 39.9 million stg in the six months to September 30 on total income of 105.5 million stg compared to 94.3 million in the same period last year.
The LSE said costs were held at 65.6 million stg, three percent lower than last year's 67.9 million stg.
It said it was making provisions for "the major organisational and trading system changes envisaged in order to deliver its strategy."

After provisions, tax and interest, the Exchange produced a surplus of 9.7 million stg and said it "expects to complete the year in a satisfactory financial position." -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
